title: The Charlie Parker Foundation streets in Kansas City
summary: Five streets in a housing development named after Parker foundation, including hers, with sponsorship by Hallmark.

blocks.x: I think you should mention for the sake of the tape -
For the sake of the tape that we should mention what you're retalking about.
The Charlie Parker Foundation and the streets that were named after such artists as Ella Fitzgerald, Count Basie,

Bennie Moten, Mary Lou Williams, and Dizzy Gillespie, five of us. But it was the way in which they did it. It was a big deal. I know they must have spent a fortune doing it, had a party and Gloria Vanderbilt, her husband, and the Hallmark people were sponsoring the Charlie Parker Foundation.
Were they the sponsors for it?

Yeah, they own practically Kansas City and this Hotel they built, it opened the same day that I got there. The governor, the mayor, and oh, just a big thing. Duke Ellington was there, Count Basie with his band, but no big exploitation on the outside of Kansas City. They raised a lot of money and they charged about $50 a plate. Had 2 or 3 nights of that.
That was a big deal and what's it called, Charlie Parker Houses?
But it's a housing development, and these are the streets in the housing development and the housing development is named after Charlie Parker.
Right. /We were trying to get you to go there.
Oh, they were after me to go.

None of the newspaper men - Leonard Feather had to do something and the guy with the New Yorker and all the newspaper men should have been there. Look at the Newport Jazz Festival. They all went there at one time or another.
But none of them came from out of the -
